readings.Aries: Leadership is not volume. Today, the quieter approach covers more ground. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Taurus: Security is not something you find. It is something you construct, slowly, from trustworthy materials. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Gemini: The question you keep asking is really a different question underneath. Find it. Let this one be easy.
readings.Cancer: You've given your energy to a situation that cannot return it. Time to redirect. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Leo: Your loyalty is total and it's not being matched. This is worth acknowledging. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Virgo: The work is excellent. The person doing the work has needs that the work doesn't meet. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Libra: You want harmony. You also want honesty. Today they are in conflict. Choose honesty. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Scorpio: Something ended. You don't have to perform recovery for anyone. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Sagittarius: Your generosity of spirit is real and sometimes extended to people who don't respect it. Discern. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Capricorn: The reputation you've built is accurate. There are parts of you it doesn't include. Show one of them. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Aquarius: The freedom you've designed for yourself has some unexpected furniture in it. Examine what you chose. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Pisces: Something you're avoiding is actually not as bad as what avoiding it costs you. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
